task.description:
Produce a design artefact at src/design/expr.md for the Stage 7 Expression DSL — DSL-01 (Grammar conformance).

Key references:
- Architecture §5.1 in docs/addon-1/01-architecture.md — the grammar BNF and built-in function whitelist
- docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md §Stage 7 — DSL-01 acceptance criteria
- docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md §6 — design artefact format

The design artefact must specify:
1. Module layout: src/expr/ containing lexer.zig, parser.zig, ast.zig, error.zig, and mod.zig (public API)
2. Token types: all terminals from the grammar (identifiers, literals, operators, keywords: and/or/not, built-in function names, parentheses, comma, dot)
3. AST node tagged union covering all 9 grammar productions: OrExpr, AndExpr, NotExpr, CmpExpr, AddExpr, MulExpr, UnaryExpr, Primary (number/string/bool/null/identifier/dot-path/grouped), FuncCall
4. Error type: ParseError with fields: line: u32, column: u32, token: []const u8, message: []const u8
5. Parser API: pub fn parse(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, source: []const u8) !Ast
   - Returns !Ast on success; on failure returns ParseError (or a list of ParseErrors for DSL-03 multi-error recovery)
6. Lexer design: single-pass, produces a Token slice consumed by the recursive descent parser
7. Memory model: caller owns the returned Ast; arena-backed allocation recommended
8. File placement: src/expr/ is a new module — no existing files are modified

Do NOT write implementation code. Produce only the design artefact (src/design/expr.md).
acceptance_criteria: src/design/expr.md exists and covers all 8 items in the task description
All 9 grammar productions are represented in the AST node design
ParseError type includes line, column, token, and message fields
Public parse() API signature is fully specified
No Zig implementation code written — design artefact only

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/expr.md produced for the Stage 7 Expression DSL module. Covers module layout (lexer.zig, parser.zig, ast.zig, error.zig, mod.zig), all token types derived from the Architecture §5.1 grammar, the complete AST node tagged union for all 9 grammar productions, ParseError struct with line/column/token/message fields, public parse() and evaluate() API signatures, single-pass lexer design, arena-backed memory model with caller-owns-Ast contract, and an evaluator stub interface anticipating DSL-04/06.
